data.title: Social Development Bank Wins 'Best Financier for Women Entrepreneurs' for Third Consecutive Year
data.content:
Singapore, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Social Development Bank has been named the "Best Financier for Women Entrepreneurs" in the Middle East and North Africa for the third consecutive time at the Global SME Finance Awards 2026, held in Singapore and organized by the SME Finance Forum.
    This sustained regional and international recognition cements the bank's position as a global model for women's economic empowerment, highlighting its success in designing an integrated ecosystem of innovative financial and nonfinancial solutions tailored to the needs of female entrepreneurs.
    The award reflects the impact of the bank's specialized programs and initiatives in expanding financial inclusion and overcoming challenges faced by women entrepreneurs. These efforts contribute to enhancing women's participation in the development of the small and medium enterprises sector and the national economy.
    
    -- SPA
